display_title: The Counterattack of the Heroine's Friend
description:
The thrilling counterattack of the female lead's friend against the fabricated female lead! The pitiful Mia, who served as the villainess protagonist's handmaiden, died after being wrongfully accused. That was Chae Mia's past life. Always standing by the villainess's side, passively watching her wicked deeds, running away simply because she was afraid... Deeply disillusioned by her own weakness, Mia hears an unknown voice...

\[If you could go back, would you make different choices?\]

 *'Go back...? Could I really change if I went back...? But... if I don't even try, I'll never change for the rest of my life...!'*

Mia resolved to return to her past life and change her actions. And so, she regressed to the very moment she first met the female protagonist who had tormented her.

 *‘I will absolutely live a life I can be proud of.’*

Right then and there, Mia's counterattack began. 

 *“The thrilling counterattack of the ‘female lead's friend’ against the fabricated ‘female lead’!”*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
